fields.Name: Zoom
fields.Description: Zoom, through a Server-to-Server OAuth app. Creates and deletes the meeting, registers attendees, and fetches the transcript of a recorded meeting.

_comments: The video providers Tasks knows, shipped inactive until a host gives each a credential (MJ: Credentials, type Video Provider OAuth) and turns it on. Their drivers register under DriverClass with MemberJunction's class factory (VideoProviderBase).

fields.Name: Microsoft Teams
fields.Description: Microsoft Teams. Until MemberJunction's calendars (A18) create the online meeting with the event, this driver reads the join details back.

fields.Name: Google Meet
fields.Description: Google Meet. Until MemberJunction's calendars (A18) create the conference with the event, this driver reads the join details back.
